label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is _____.
verse: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
note: The sin of omission — knowing the good and skipping it anyway.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my _____ shall not pass away.
verse: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
note: Heaven and earth have an expiration date; Jesus's words don't. That's a lot of confidence in one sentence.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us _____ to eat, and water to drink.
verse: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
note: 'Pulse' means vegetables — Daniel's ten-day veggie challenge against the king's rich menu.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I _____ to the God of heaven.
verse: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
note: Nehemiah's arrow prayer: between the king's question and his answer, a silent word to heaven.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And my speech and my preaching was not with _____ words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
verse: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
note: Paul's preaching in Corinth: no 'enticing words' of clever rhetoric, just a demonstration of the Spirit and power.
